reason: Most of the free work it would find is free on purpose. That's how I keep clients who've been with me fifteen years, and I'm not paying £99 a month to be told what I already know and won't go and chase.
objection: Potential leakage isn't money in the bank. Every figure means an awkward call to a client I like, so the most likely result is a list of uncomfortable numbers and no extra revenue.
would_change_my_mind: If the free audit turned up real unbilled licences or a client clearly past their agreement, the kind of thing I can put on an invoice or into a renewal without a row, and enough of it to cover the fee several times over.
